$comment: The dispatcher's half of a Clara morning call, shared by every check-in
case via `variables_from`. Not a case file — `discover` only picks up
*.case.json — and deliberately not named like one.
This is the audio twin of `prompts/clara/tests/cases/_fixtures.js` in
usan-retirement-backend, and it holds the same values for the same
reasons: nothing backfills a dynamic variable here, the check-in prompt
reads sixteen of them, and an omitted one reaches the model as literal
braces that can be read to the listener.
A listener consistent with herself: the state, the timezone, the clock
and the medication list all agree, so no branch of the prompt is reading
one thing while another says something else.
`current_time` is pinned even though a real call would compute it. A
stored variable wins over the platform's system default (worker
`variables.py`, ResolutionVariables.__missing__), so pinning it is what
stops a suite run at 9pm from grading the morning script against an
